correctness.rationale: The unique shorter spherical geodesic has strictly positive sine interpolation weights; its projection lies on the minor planar angular cone. For azimuths in [0,alpha], alpha<2pi, escape is equivalent a.s. to |phi_i-phi_j|>pi. Thus low and high endpoint intervals form nested bipartite neighborhoods. Order-statistic range integration gives no-edge probability n(1-q)^(n-1)-(n-1)(1-q)^n and elementary edge-indicator covariances give the stated mean and variance. Under alpha_n=pi(1+lambda/n), independent multinomial rare endpoint counts converge to two unit-rate Poisson processes, and the strict inequality s+t<lambda is almost surely continuous. An independently written checker tested exact finite-sample formulas, nestedness and Monte Carlo moments; analytical arguments establish the all-n graph convergence.
